title: Component page blocks
description: Allowed block types for a component (free-composition) page. All registered landing block types are permitted; each block's `data` is validated per its own type via ../block-item.json. The enum mirrors the frontend block registry (packages/blocks register-renderers.ts) so any block the builder can add validates here — image_gallery/property_listing/real_estate_profile/main_page/cover_page were previously missing (QCG-19801); gs1_info was missing too (QCG-00000), blocking publish on any page carrying it (PATCH /qr/<id>/ {publish:true} 400ing with a 'gs1_info' is not one of [...] enum error).
